cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Join my campaign to save the club garden.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Our extension plan. The one we both signed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We know the opposition's weaknesses. Will you join the honest version?

mechanism: A recruits under an apparently simple cause, then assumes leadership in redefining the side B has joined when the true conflict emerges.
confusable: Distinguish enlarging a chore from revealing that the conflict or alliance itself differs from the initial offer.
comparison: Cupboard tidying becomes a leadership challenge; garden defense becomes opposition to a plan both characters signed.
seedUse: Use canonical cupboard and garden seeds; S01 must determine the new alignment in response to B questions, not merely decorate a second recruitment plea.
